result.rationale: The finding claims `<%- end if %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb produces a bare `end if` with no following condition, causing a Ruby syntax error and a 500 on every /embed/best request. But the diff shows the very next template content is a blank line and then `<%= link_to(image_tag(...), Discourse.base_url) %>`, which ERB compiles into an `_erbout << ...` output statement immediately after the `end if` line. Since Ruby's parser is in expression-begin state after the `if` keyword, the newline is ignored and the following expression (`_erbout << "\n"`) becomes the condition of the modifier

parsed_response.reasoning: The finding claims `<%- end if %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb produces a bare `end if` with no following condition, causing a Ruby syntax error and a 500 on every /embed/best request. But the diff shows the very next template content is a blank line and then `<%= link_to(image_tag(...), Discourse.base_url) %>`, which ERB compiles into an `_erbout << ...` output statement immediately after the `end if` line. Since Ruby's parser is in expression-begin state after the `if` keyword, the newline is ignored and the following expression (`_erbout << "\n"`) becomes the condition of the modifier — valid Ruby that compiles and executes (the appended-string expression is always truthy, so the if/else still renders and the logo line still outputs). The claimed mechanism (syntax error, permanent 500) therefore does not occur; the template compiles and renders the header. The finding misreads how the ERB-generated code parses, not an actual defect introduced by the diff.

judged_text: The fragment `<%- end if %>` compiles to a bare `end if` with no condition on the generated line (the next generated line is the following output statement), which is a Ruby syntax error, so best.html.erb fails to compile. Every request to /embed/best for a URL that already has a topic raises ActionView::SyntaxError and returns a 500 instead of the comment list, so the embed widget permanently breaks after the first successful background retrieval; no spec catches it because the controller specs never render views.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, the header block ends with `<%- end if %>`, which emits Ruby code `end if` with no condition. Ruby only allows `end if <condition>` (modifier form) when a condition follows; `end if` alone is a syntax error. Since this template is used by `EmbedController#best` when a topic exists (`@topic_view` is set and the view is rendered), the view will fail to compile at runtime with an `ActionView::SyntaxError`.
